turnaround_reason: Inspire, maker of the hypoglossal-nerve-stimulation implant for obstructive sleep apnea, collapsed ~58% from its 52-week high on fears that GLP-1 drugs (Zepbound, now FDA-approved for OSA) shrink its addressable market, compounded by reimbursement/coding uncertainty and a guidance cut to $900-910M.
bullish_points: Exceptional business quality: 86% gross margin, positive net margin (15%), and a near-net-cash balance sheet ($320M cash vs $29M debt)
Inspire's own survey of 200+ sleep physicians suggests GLP-1 availability is increasing the number of patients seeking OSA diagnosis/treatment, potentially expanding the funnel
Clinical momentum (SLEEP 2026 presence, PREDICTOR study) supports the durability of the therapy
Deeply de-rated toward the 52-week low with a still-underpenetrated OSA implant market
Category-defining device with limited direct implant competition
bearish_points: GLP-1 threat is genuine and multi-year: some physicians will trial a GLP-1 before considering Inspire, delaying/reducing demand
BofA downgrade cites slower growth, reimbursement and coding/insurance billing confusion — a self-inflicted near-term headwind
One analyst flags the problem lasting into 2028, i.e. no quick fix
Revenue growth already negative (-7.6%); a former hyper-grower is now shrinking
'Basing' is unconfirmed (technicals null); high risk of re-breakdown on another guide or coding setback
catalyst: Resolution of the reimbursement/coding confusion and evidence that GLP-1s expand rather than cannibalize the OSA funnel, shown in stabilizing revenue growth
catalyst_timing: Next 1-2 earnings prints (2H 2026); coding clarity could extend into 2027
suggested_trade: Small spot starter near the low; wait for a growth-stabilization print before adding
key_risk: GLP-1 adoption structurally caps the implant TAM and coding headwinds persist into 2027-2028
would_skip_if: Another guidance cut or worsening coding/reimbursement commentary
note: Existing deep-dive research note already present at data/research/INSP.md; not redone.
